ICS: What was it like taking care of this patient? What was the most distressing aspect of caring for this patient? What was the most satisfying aspect of caring for this patient?
What thoughts or feelings are you experiencing since the distressing event?
How do you take care of yourself so you can continue to provide care for other patients and families? What will you do to support yourself as you process this situation? Review available resources
